SYS-API-032.rule: Reuse baseline PUT exactly: body version is CAS, PUT replacement is idempotent, response is synchronous; no Idempotency-Key, If-Match, or durable receipt may be invented.

constraints.identifiers: UUID public identifiers; version is integer >=1
constraints.time: RFC3339 instants; ISO-8601 business dates; effective periods are [from,to)
constraints.commands: All local commands require Idempotency-Key, CAS where aggregate mutation occurs, and durable receipt. SYS-API-032 is the only accepted baseline exception.
constraints.homePreference: SYS-API-031/032 reuse usr_home_preferences and baseline API; surfaceKey is exactly hcm-home; no new table or duty
